findings: FirstGroup plc Half-Yearly Report for the 26 weeks to 27 September 2025, published 18 November 2025 (CEO signed 17 November 2025) — source: /workspace/docs/data/research_director_worker/FGP.L/20260904T164856Z/sources/filings/bodies/c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Group adjusted revenue rose 30% to £833.6m (H1 2025: £639.6m; H1 2025 re-presented down £10m from £649.6m as reported); adjusted operating profit £103.6m (H1 2025: £100.8m); margin 12.4% vs 15.8%; adjusted EPS +16% to 9.9p (H1 2025: 8.5p), aided by 22m share buybacks and weighted average shares 559.7m vs 608.5m — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

First Bus: revenue £702.9m (+37% vs £513.7m); adjusted operating profit £42.7m (+4% vs £41.1m); margin 6.1% vs 8.0%. Regional Bus revenue £442.1m (+3.5%); Business & Coach £105.4m; Franchising £155.4m incl. First Bus London £150.2m (acquired Feb 2025). First Bus London performing ahead of acquisition assumptions — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

First Rail: adjusted revenue £130.9m (+4.9% vs £126.0m); adjusted operating profit £66.6m (-1.3% vs £67.9m). DfT TOC adjusted revenue £24.1m (£26.0m) and adj. op. profit £39.7m (£44.1m); open access + Rail Services revenue £106.8m (+6.8%) and adj. op. profit £26.9m (+3.1%). Open access revenue £53.2m; Rail Services £53.6m — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Bus passenger KPIs: underlying volumes -4% YoY (excl. London and acquisitions since H1 2025); concessionary +4%; commercial -7% (attributed to £3 fare cap, lower consumer confidence, modal shift). Reported passenger volumes 196m vs 204m (excl. London). Open access rail journeys 1.43m (+2% vs 1.40m) — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Free cash outflow £35.6m (H1 2025: +£2.6m inflow), driven by accelerated First Bus electrification capex; adjusted cash outflow £212.2m (H1 2025: £7.8m). H1 cash capex £136.4m; First Bus net capex £110.6m; FY 2026 net capex guided c.£180m (bus decarbonisation). c.£76m returned to shareholders (£49m buyback + FY25 final dividend); interim dividend 2.2p (H1 2025: 1.7p), c.£12.0m payable 30 Dec 2025 — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Adjusted net debt £207.6m at 27 Sep 2025 (FY 2025: £86.9m; H1 2025 comparative £0.2m); reported net debt £992.0m. FY 2026 year-end adjusted net debt forecast £125m–£135m before growth capital. Movement in adjusted net debt in H1: +£120.7m, reflecting ring-fenced cash +£82.9m and IFRS 16 lease liability reduction — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Management frames H1 as a 'period of transition': bus industry shift from £2 to £3 fare cap; UK bus and rail industries 'transition' with portfolio diversification; business restructuring delivered c.£6m of £15m annualised savings in H1 — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Franchise roll-off / nationalisation: SWR transferred to DfTO 25 May 2025; c2c 20 Jul 2025; Greater Anglia 12 Oct 2025; West Midlands expected 1 Feb 2026; GTR 31 May 2026; remaining five NRCs ~3-month intervals. Government policy to bring NRCs into public ownership 'at the earliest possible opportunity'. DfT TOCs focused on delivery ahead of transfer; FY 2026 First Rail adj. revenue/profit expected marginally lower — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Anticipated c.£125m cash inflow from DfT TOCs over three years from Oct 2025 (management fees a year in arrears), net of reorganisation costs; includes Rail Services continuing ≥1 year post-NRC end. SWR ring-fenced cash £64.1m anticipated returned in due course — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Debt/cash colour attributed to the print: free cash outflow explicitly linked to accelerated First Bus electrification investment (£105m H1 net investment; £83.4m decarbonisation in period); adjusted net debt rise from £86.9m to £207.6m; working capital outflow £91.9m incl. £85.9m First Rail ring-fenced cash movement; buybacks £48.7m and dividends £26.9m also cited in adjusted cash bridge — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt

Outlook: modest adjusted EPS growth FY 2026; at least maintain adjusted EPS FY 2027. First Bus FY revenue c.£1.4bn (c.£300m London). Group expects to mitigate c.£16m Group / c.£15m Bus annualised employers' NI impact — source: c1db8cdf5ad2bd84.txt
